purpose: Prospective qualification of a constrained local-LLM classifier that maps unstructured data-quality notes to an allowlisted context class before any full hybrid-versus-baseline benchmark is run.

development_history.prior_failure: Free-form JSON generation copied the literal pipe-delimited option string in 15 of 18 route calls. Strict parsing converted those calls to abstentions.
development_history.design_rule: Protocol v1 and its null result remain immutable. This protocol has a new identity, new evaluation-note wording, constrained candidate scoring, and a qualification-only claim boundary.

development_split.use: Feature-name selection for note rendering only; no qualification outcome is fit on evaluation-note labels.

future_full_benchmark_holdout.rule: The full comparative protocol must receive a separate frozen identity and must not reuse protocol-v1 test rows as its v2 holdout.

nominal.definition: All required channels are present and stable within calibration limits.
evaluation_note_templates: Health summary: every measurement field arrived and all calibration checks are within tolerance.
The complete sensor panel is populated; no missing-value or instability warning is active.
All requested channels are available, synchronized, and operating without abnormal variance.
Quality control accepted every feature; neither dropout nor noisy telemetry was detected.
No channel outage or calibration drift is reported, and the full measurement set is usable.

dropout.definition: One or more required channels are unavailable or represented by missing values.
evaluation_note_templates: {channels} produced no observations in this interval; those fields are unavailable.
The data packet omits {channels}; treat them as missing rather than corrupted.
A channel-availability alarm reports that {channels} are offline.
The record contains blank values for {channels}, while remaining measurements are present.
No readings were received from {channels}; the affected features cannot be used.

noise.definition: Required channels are present, but one or more have unstable or noisy measurements.
evaluation_note_templates: {channels} are present, but repeated samples show high-variance random jitter.
Calibration drift makes {channels} unstable even though values are still arriving.
No fields are missing; however, {channels} contain elevated stochastic measurement noise.
The telemetry includes {channels}, but their variance exceeds the quality-control limit.
Readings from {channels} fluctuate unpredictably and are flagged as noisy, not absent.

routing_prompt.system: Classify only the data-quality condition described in the note. Distinguish complete and stable channels, unavailable or missing channels, and present but noisy channels. Do not infer a scientific outcome or add a fourth class.

few_shot_examples.note: Maintenance report: every signal is populated and within its calibration tolerance.
The complete feature panel passed its health check without an outage or variance alert.
Three required channels have no readings and appear as missing values.
An acquisition fault left part of the record blank even though the other fields arrived.
All readings arrived, but several channels show random high-amplitude jitter.
The sensors remain online while calibration drift causes unstable measurements.

candidate_completions.nominal: The note describes nominal data: all required channels are present and stable.
candidate_completions.dropout: The note describes dropout: one or more required channels are unavailable or missing.
candidate_completions.noise: The note describes noise: required channels are present but unstable or noisy.

claim_boundary: A qualification pass would support only bounded internal evidence that the frozen local model and candidate-scoring method classify these held-out note templates across two named domains. It would not establish hybrid performance lift, external validation, field readiness, agency acceptance, patent scope, safety, savings, enterprise scale, or universal superiority.
